scenarios.title: Public routes remain reachable and correctly projected
scenarios.claim: Public product routes resolve to the intended surface without browser errors.

scenarios.title: Console routes remain reachable across supported viewports
scenarios.claim: Every console route resolves with its canonical URL, heading, responsive bounds, and clean browser diagnostics.

scenarios.title: Portal routes remain reachable across supported viewports
scenarios.claim: Every developer portal route resolves with the intended authorization projection and clean browser diagnostics.

scenarios.title: First install initializes one enterprise instance
scenarios.claim: An empty dedicated runtime can initialize exactly one enterprise administrator and persist setup state.

scenarios.title: Official website is public localized and responsive
scenarios.claim: The official website renders real product content in English and Simplified Chinese with responsive and accessibility checks.

scenarios.title: Legal documents are public and selectable
scenarios.claim: Published legal documents are reachable without authentication and unknown slugs fail visibly.

scenarios.title: Registration verification and account security lifecycle
scenarios.claim: A developer registers, verifies email, requests recovery and verification messages, updates the profile and password, enables TOTP, rotates recovery codes, signs in with both factors, revokes another session, disables TOTP, and retains the persisted account projection.

scenarios.title: OIDC account identity binding and unbinding lifecycle
scenarios.claim: A registered member starts OIDC binding through the visible account action, authorizes at an isolated HTTPS issuer, completes the real PKCE callback and JWT verification, reloads the persisted bound identity, confirms unbinding, reloads the unbound projection, and exposes exact bound and unbound audit evidence for that member.

scenarios.title: Public authentication pages reject invalid links
scenarios.claim: Public account recovery and verification surfaces expose validation failures without accepting invalid tokens.

scenarios.title: Logout immediately revokes a user session
scenarios.claim: Logout revokes the server session and protected APIs reject the old token.

scenarios.title: Role changes and disabling revoke user sessions
scenarios.claim: Identity role and status changes invalidate existing sessions and enforce the new surface boundary.

scenarios.title: Backend health and public settings are ready
scenarios.claim: Health, readiness, and public settings agree that the isolated enterprise runtime is ready.

scenarios.title: Anonymous protected navigation redirects to login
scenarios.claim: Anonymous console navigation preserves the intended redirect without disclosing protected content.

scenarios.title: Login persists and opens the management console
scenarios.claim: An enterprise administrator signs in, reloads, and remains on the canonical console entry.

scenarios.title: Credential editor exposes enterprise ownership only
scenarios.claim: Workspace credentials expose only enterprise key types and no retired customer ownership model.

scenarios.title: Application and policy lists remain usable
scenarios.claim: Core enterprise list pages render their data table contracts without overflow.

scenarios.title: Locale theme and responsive state persist
scenarios.claim: Locale and theme persist after reload and remain operable at all supported viewports.

scenarios.title: Application and workspace key lifecycle is auditable
scenarios.claim: An administrator creates and updates an application and governance policy, issues then edits a one-time Workspace Key to bind that policy, verifies the selected policy explanation, reloads secrets masked and state persisted, rotates and disables the key, and observes exact audit evidence.

scenarios.title: Enterprise identity and organization lifecycle remains scoped
scenarios.claim: An administrator creates and updates a department, creates a member, creates updates and deletes a group, grants a scoped role assignment, reloads each read model, revokes the assignment, and observes audit evidence.

scenarios.title: Developer portal key and usage projection is isolated
scenarios.claim: A developer sees only the portal projection, creates and rotates an allowed key, inspects access and usage, and cannot enter the console.

scenarios.title: Gateway evidence reaches enterprise operations views
scenarios.claim: Gateway traffic produces usage, supply, allocation, and Trace read models; a real durable image job requeues under provider capacity, is canceled through the UI with reload and audit persistence, then another job succeeds with a persisted image Artifact whose preview pixels and downloaded PNG bytes are verified; quota alerts and asynchronous usage exports complete their lifecycle.

scenarios.title: Filtered operational records export exact CSV rows
scenarios.claim: One real gateway request is filtered through the Usage, Cost Allocation, Gateway Trace, and Audit views; each visible Export action downloads a typed CSV containing exactly the target record with matching model, key, provider, token, status, and audit evidence.

scenarios.title: Unknown provider attempts can be scheduled for reconciliation
scenarios.claim: A real durable image dispatch enters running/unknown after an upstream 500; an administrator opens its details, schedules immediate reconciliation through the UI, reloads the persisted state, and verifies the exact attempt audit event without claiming provider recovery.

scenarios.title: Failed customer artifact delivery retries to stored bytes
scenarios.claim: A durable image job reaches a real customer-sink delivery failure through the AWS SDK, the administrator retries it through the UI after the sink recovers, and the Artifact reloads as delivered with exact object bytes, media type, signed destination request, lifecycle events, and retry audit evidence.

scenarios.title: Provider account discovery requires explicit apply
scenarios.claim: A provider account persists empty inventory until discovery and explicit application.

scenarios.title: Provider supply lifecycle persists and protects dependencies
scenarios.claim: An administrator creates updates and health-checks a provider and account, toggles scheduling, creates and updates a gateway model and route, observes referenced-account deletion fail closed, then deletes the route model and account in dependency order with audit evidence.

scenarios.title: Model inventory and bulk routes stay auditable
scenarios.claim: Providers, accounts, published models, and bulk routes remain connected and auditable across responsive layouts.

scenarios.title: Model Hub compares routes and persists policy actions
scenarios.claim: An enterprise administrator compares approved supply routes by model family, model, and route, inspects actual and reference prices, multiplier, and runtime evidence, writes preferred resources and ordered batches into an existing routing policy, reloads the persisted state, and verifies localized responsive projections.

scenarios.title: Routing policy lifecycle persists and remains explainable
scenarios.claim: An enterprise routing policy is created through visible controls, advances through three persisted versions, binds explicitly to one compatible Workspace Key, and proves per-model price caps, missing-price block and allow behavior, strict declared order, same-batch preferred resources, explicit-policy simulation evidence, localization, accessibility, and responsive projections.

scenarios.title: Routing policy preferences defaults and conflicts remain governed
scenarios.claim: An enterprise administrator selects and persists speed, stability, and balanced preferences, verifies active and disabled projections, operates the policy list by keyboard, and sees both required-field validation and the real API rejection when a route group would gain two active default policies.

scenarios.title: Routing policy constraints batches and resilience controls round-trip
scenarios.claim: An enterprise administrator persists native-protocol and price constraints, model and protocol admission rules, automatic, percentile, and strict low-price pools, ordered fallback batches, resource preference cleanup, pre-first-byte failover, sticky TTL, effective-cost optimization, and strict declared order through visible controls and reloads.

scenarios.title: Route groups and simulator use the published routing contract
scenarios.claim: A route group is created, updated with persisted cost and capacity settings after reload, and consumed by the simulator to explain a decision using published model supply.

scenarios.title: Expression pricing lifecycle remains usable
scenarios.claim: A pricing rule is created, validated, simulated, published as two versions, switched back to version one, applied to a real Gateway settlement whose persisted evaluation is queried through the UI, then disabled and reloaded with exact version and cost evidence.

scenarios.title: Measured provider switch reaches canary with persisted evidence
scenarios.claim: Two independently routed Gateway requests create comparable usage for the same upstream model; UI-created exact procurement prices and an imported provider bill reconcile the upstream request back to persisted usage, a persisted cache capability drives a real three-request warm/reuse/control probe, and the resulting lower-cost recommendation enters a 25% canary with refresh, empty-window history, and audit evidence.

scenarios.title: Billing evidence remains distinct from bill lines
scenarios.claim: Aggregate provider evidence cannot be presented as precise billing lines or automatic routing eligibility.

scenarios.title: Provider to gateway request records evidence
scenarios.claim: A successful provider route returns a response and records typed usage, Trace, pricing, audit, and policy evidence.

scenarios.title: Native text protocols cross the complete gateway evidence pipeline
scenarios.claim: OpenAI Responses, Anthropic Messages, and Gemini GenerateContent JSON and streaming calls cross authentication, routing, protocol translation, usage, trace, audit, model rejection, and upstream-rate-limit boundaries.

scenarios.title: Quota and budget warn escalate and reject with evidence
scenarios.claim: Quota and budget thresholds warn once, escalate, reject fail-closed, and preserve evidence.

scenarios.title: Failed primary route falls back and records attempts
scenarios.claim: A retryable primary failure selects an eligible fallback and records every route attempt.

scenarios.title: Provider cooldown can be cleared and traffic recovers
scenarios.claim: A real upstream 500 matches the account's configured long cooldown rule, opens the circuit, blocks the next Gateway request, projects the cooldown in the provider-account UI, clears every failure state through the visible action, persists the cleared state across reload, restores successful Gateway traffic, and records trace plus audit evidence.

scenarios.title: Department and owner isolation covers reads writes and exports
scenarios.claim: Department and ownership scopes protect list, mutation, detail, evidence, and export paths without disclosure.

scenarios.title: Plugin management lifecycle is governed and auditable
scenarios.claim: An administrator reaches the canonical Plugin Center, observes locked entitlements fail closed, enables and configures a free plugin without secret disclosure, persists state across reload, inspects delivery records, issues and revokes a scoped API token, and observes plugin audit evidence.

scenarios.title: Signed official plugin trust chain crosses the browser and runtime
scenarios.claim: An administrator verifies signed catalog, License, encrypted Feed, online and offline package delivery, installation, runtime projection, frontend workbench assets, and uninstall through the product UI without a production trust bypass.

scenarios.title: Customer-owned object storage secrets stay masked
scenarios.claim: Object-storage destinations can be managed without disclosing stored access, secret, or session credentials.

scenarios.title: Email settings and localized templates remain manageable
scenarios.claim: An administrator verifies a STARTTLS connection with unsaved credentials, delivers and inspects SMTP and rendered template messages, then customizes, reloads, restores, and localizes the template without exposing or persisting the test SMTP configuration.

scenarios.title: Admin settings persist and retention cleanup is evidenced
scenarios.claim: An administrator changes data governance settings, saves and reloads the persisted values, confirms retention cleanup through the product UI with deletion evidence, and restores the original values.

scenarios.title: Diagnostic bundle is downloadable, redacted, and audited
scenarios.claim: An administrator creates and downloads a real diagnostic archive through the product UI, verifies its exact byte size and typed runtime health payload, confirms secrets and database URLs are absent, and observes the persisted system audit event.

scenarios.title: Signed system update metadata and maintenance commands fail closed
scenarios.claim: An administrator checks a real signed official release, sees the source-build manual-update boundary, receives controlled rejection for one-click update and restart, receives an explicit missing-backup rollback failure, and observes audit evidence for every action.

scenarios.title: Managed release binary updates, restarts, rolls back, and restarts
scenarios.claim: An administrator uses the browser to apply a signed matching release asset to an isolated executable, proves the on-disk SHA and rollback backup, restarts through a dedicated supervisor into the new version, rolls the executable back, restarts into the old version, and verifies persistent audit evidence across all three process generations.

scenarios.title: PostgreSQL backup restores local and S3 state
scenarios.claim: An administrator verifies the configured S3 store through the UI, creates a real pg_dump backup, reloads local and remote listings, downloads byte-identical local and S3 archives, writes database markers after the snapshot, restores locally and from S3 through confirmed visible actions, proves each marker is removed by pg_restore, and observes exact backup and restore audit evidence.

scenarios.title: Console overview has no serious accessibility violations
scenarios.claim: The primary console entry has no serious or critical automated accessibility violations.

scenarios.title: Enterprise member sessions are isolated and keyboard operable
scenarios.claim: Concurrent member/admin browser contexts remain isolated and core controls are keyboard operable.
